summary: - **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the whole HepMC3 event position as well as the vertices. Previously the beam particles, which come from the root vertex, stayed at (0,0,0) while all other vertices were smeared. Beam particles now start at the smeared interaction point, and this was confirmed to fix the reported problem.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the HepMC3 length unit to the primary vertex x/y/z coordinates. Before this fix, HepMC3 inputs written in centimetres produced wrong vertex positions in DDG4 simulation; millimetre files were unaffected.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1689](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1689)** — The EDM4hep reader in DDG4 now handles the new MDI synchrotron-radiation file format. These files contain parentless photons, and the reader now uses each photon's vertex (not its endpoint) as the Geant4 starting point. The HepMC3 reader has no equivalent support for this event structure yet.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws an exception when shared actions are used in single-threaded mode. Previously this silently wrote events twice. The DDSim `OutputConfig` user-output-plugin example was fixed for multi-threaded running. Steering files with user output plugins need adapting to the shared `kernel()` pattern.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#391](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/391)** — The IDEA and ALLEGRO (o1/o2) ddsim steering files now set the output plugin's shared flag only for multi-threaded running. This adopts the DD4hep#1678 kernel usage and prevents duplicated events or exceptions in single-threaded jobs.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`, configured through three new properties: `UseHitTimeInCKF` adds hit time as a CKF measurement dimension. `HitTimeResolutions` sets per-sensor time resolutions. `SeedFinding_DoubletTimeCutNSigma` applies a time-of-flight-corrected ACTS doublet time cut. The per-sensor resolutions are a placeholder until EDM4hep stores a per-hit time error. The PR also requires an ACTS version that includes acts#6101.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg`, together with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Configurations still using it must migrate to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag that contains the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes two `OverlayTiming` bugs that predate the recent OverlayTiming work in k4FWCore#413: `StartBackgroundEventIndex` was re-applied every event, so the same background events were overlaid repeatedly. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` was never enforced. Jobs that relied on silent wrap-around now fail unless `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` is set.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes `TracksFromGenParticles` reading uninitialized ECAL geometry when `ExtrapolateToECal=False`. This bug could attach calorimeter track states extrapolated with garbage geometry to tracks. Extrapolation now runs only when requested, geometry lookup failures return `FAILURE`, and cellIDs are no longer truncated to 32 bits.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/102)** — Refactors `GGTFTrackFinder` and fixes a wire-hit collection index that was never incremented. With more than one wire input, that bug associated hits with the wrong collection. Noise/unclustered hits (cluster ID ≤ 0) no longer produce an output track, so the former cluster-0 track disappears from `GGTFTracks`; other tracks are validated as identical.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)** — `PairCaloClustersPi0` now uses Boost.Graph's maximum-matching algorithm, which is O(N³), instead of an exponential exhaustive search. The old search exhausted memory on hadronic events. The new version is validated to give the same pairs, and the pi0 candidates are now sorted.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — `ConformalTracking` gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID`/`ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties, which default to the ILD/CLD values (20, 29). This allows detectors such as ALLEGRO (system IDs 4, 5) to get track states at the calorimeter face. Further changes: `GaudiDDKalTest` installs electromagnetic calorimeters identified by their type flags. A missing calo-face state no longer fails the track fit.
